top_signals.title: Kenya Plans Corn Imports After Crop Failure Due to Bad Weather

top_signals.title: Zilch, Clearscore among five UK scale-ups to get dedicated FCA support
top_signals.summary: The UK’s financial watchdog is to offer extra regulatory support to five British scale-ups as it seeks to ease the burden on fast-growing firms.
